_comment: Measured from the recorded SATB takes by scripts/analyze_harmony. Regenerate if the recordings are replaced.
_lead_in_note: Seconds of silence before the first sung note. Playback starts here so the downbeat lands with the singer.
_tuning_note: The takes sit ~21 cents below concert pitch (implied A=434.7Hz). ALZONA sounds the start note before the count-in so the singer matches the recording rather than a tuner.
_boundaries_note: Gaps present in EVERY part - safe places to stop the ensemble without cutting a word.
